result.title: Harness-S: Learning from Sibling Harnesses for Generalizable Agent Training
result.comment: Code: https://github.com/DeepExperience/Harness-S; Keywords: Language model agents, agent harnesses, reinforcement learning, harness complementarity, harness routing
result.summary: Harness evolution from a common base exhibits Locality, Complementarity, and Nonstationarity: variants repair different failures, and their utility changes as the policy learns. Rather than seeking a universally superior harness, we introduce Harness-S to selectively rescue failures of a base execution system through sibling harnesses and transfer the resulting capabilities into a single policy that remains effective under the original harness. Directional Harness Evolution develops specialized sibling harnesses along distinct repair directions, forming a reusable Sibling Harness Pool that remains fixed during policy training. Complementary Harness Rescue Training invokes this pool only when all initial attempts under the base harness fail. The same policy generates fresh rollouts under selected auxiliary harnesses, and these trajectories replace the failed group for reinforcement learning. An Adaptive Harness Router selects the Top-k variants using Harness Behavior Profiles and voting across multiple LLMs. Policy-aware profile re-anchoring refreshes this evidence as the policy learns. Across AppWorld, SWE-Gym, and DBBench, the trained policy substantially outperforms policy-only training when returned to the original base harness. Behavioral analyses and held-out cases support the transfer of harness-elicited behaviors into the policy itself. Reusing the router for Rank-1 inference provides additional gains at the same executor rollout count.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 Harness-S：从同一基座演化出多个「兄弟」执行框架，仅在基座框架初始尝试全部失败时条件性调用辅助框架重跑轨迹用于强化学习，并用路由器把获得的行为迁移回单一策略，在 AppWorld、SWE-Gym、DBBench 上验证。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「失败时才触发辅助计算、再把收益收回原策略」的机制，可能为 LVR 中何时追加视觉证据获取、以及如何把辅助通路的收益归因并固化到 latent 状态提供方法线索，但该工作面向文本 agent 框架，适用性需核查。
